fullPassage: All architectural structures are forms of spatial choreography that guides action along predefined pathways. A building shapes how we move, what we see, and whom we encounter. There is a reason, for example, that older universities typically organized classrooms along corridors that fed into larger common areas: the design of the space was _______________. Similarly, traditional office layouts with rows of desks facing a manager's office were not just functional but also symbolic, encoding a particular set of relationships and expectations about supervision and hierarchy. The design of a home, too, tells a story: the size and placement of the kitchen, the presence or absence of a front porch, the separation of public and private spaces — all of these choices reflect and shape patterns of family interaction, hospitality, and individual privacy.

✅ ③ shaping — 원문은 shapes. 'A building shapes how we move'에서 주어 A building(3인칭 단수)에 대한 본동사가 필요. shaping(현재분사)은 본동사로 기능 불가 ←정답
❌ ② organized — 과거동사. 'older universities organized classrooms'에서 주어에 대한 과거형 동사. 적절
❌ ④ reflect — 'all of these choices reflect and shape patterns'에서 복수 주어 choices에 수일치된 동사. 적절
